## ASD Essential Eight: Regular backups

> **Clear telemetry limits: Do not overstate coverage.**
>
> Microsoft Sentinel telemetry provides **partial visibility only** for the Regular backups strategy. This workbook surfaces Azure Backup job health, restore job history, protected instance inventory and vault modification events (`AddonAzureBackupJobs`, `AddonAzureBackupProtectedInstance`, `AzureActivity`) when Recovery Services vault and Backup vault diagnostics are forwarded to Log Analytics.
>
> **What cannot be evidenced from Sentinel telemetry alone (manual evidence required):**
> - **Microsoft 365 Backup**: Backup policy configuration, restore point integrity and recovery testing for Exchange Online, SharePoint and OneDrive require exports from the Microsoft 365 admin centre and Microsoft Graph / Purview audit review.
> - **Immutability lock state and offline/air-gapped media**: Confirming locked WORM immutability across every vault and verifying offline backup custody requires Azure Resource Graph inspection and physical/offsite custody records.
> - **Full disaster recovery and identity restoration exercises**: Application-level data integrity checks, RPO/RTO validation and bare-metal or Active Directory / Entra recovery drills must be evidenced through formal DR test reports under the [ASD Essential Eight Assessment Process Guide](https://www.cyber.gov.au/resources-business-and-government/essential-cyber-security/essential-eight/essential-eight-assessment-process-guide).
> - **Third-party and on-premises backup platforms**: Workloads backed up outside Azure Backup are not visible unless custom connectors are onboarded.
>
> **Disclaimer:** Independent community workbook. Not produced, endorsed or supported by ASD, ACSC or Microsoft. Refer to the [ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model](https://www.cyber.gov.au/resources-business-and-government/essential-cyber-security/essential-eight/essential-eight-maturity-model) and [Azure Backup monitoring documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/backup/backup-azure-monitoring-built-in-monitor).

content.title: Azure Backup observable telemetry KPI summary (partial coverage)

content.query:
AddonAzureBackupJobs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where JobOperation == 'Backup'
| summarize TotalJobs = count(), Completed = countif(JobStatus == 'Completed'), Warnings = countif(JobStatus == 'CompletedWithWarnings'), Failed = countif(JobStatus == 'Failed'), LastJob = max(TimeGenerated) by BackupManagementType, DatasourceType, StorageReplicationType
| extend SuccessRatePct = round(100.0 * Completed / max_of(TotalJobs, 1), 1)
| order by Failed desc, SuccessRatePct asc
content.title: Azure Backup job success rates by workload and replication type (E8-RB-ML1-01)

content.query:
AddonAzureBackupJobs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where JobOperation == 'Restore'
| project TimeGenerated, BackupItemFriendlyName, BackupManagementType, DatasourceType, JobStatus, JobDurationInSecs, RecoveryJobDestination, RecoveryJobRPDateTime, ResourceGroupName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Azure Backup restoration job history (supports ML1/ML2 quarterly test evidence)

content.query:
AddonAzureBackupProtectedInstance
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, ProtectedInstanceCount, StorageConsumedInMBs, StorageReplicationType, ArchiveTierStorageConsumedInMBs, VaultType) by VaultName, ResourceGroupName, BackupManagementType, DatasourceType
| project VaultName, VaultType, ResourceGroupName, BackupManagementType, DatasourceType, ProtectedInstanceCount, StorageReplicationType, StorageConsumedGB = round(StorageConsumedInMBs / 1024.0, 2)
| order by ProtectedInstanceCount desc
content.title: Protected instances and vault storage redundancy (AddonAzureBackupProtectedInstance)

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where OperationNameValue has_any ('Microsoft.RecoveryServices/', 'Microsoft.DataProtection/')
| where OperationNameValue has_any ('delete', 'backupconfig', 'backupPolicies', 'immutability', 'resourceGuard', 'backupProtectedItems')
| project TimeGenerated, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, Caller, CallerIpAddress, ResourceGroup, _ResourceId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Backup vault deletion, policy change and immutability modification events (E8-RB-ML1-03, E8-RB-ML2-01, E8-RB-ML3-01)
